strategy_roster.name: Exp 3XMA Ichimoku
strategy_roster.notes: EMA(9/26) is used as a Kijun/cloud proxy, so a downward cross into the proxy cloud is the documented contrarian long setup and the opposite cross exits. Ichimoku spans, exact cloud-entry state, 4-hour timeframe, and short permissions are unavailable.

strategy_roster.name: Setup: Smooth Gaussian + Adaptive Supertrend (Manual Vol)
strategy_roster.notes: A double SMA(75) is a direct proxy for the documented Gaussian trend line; positive 20-bar standard deviation is a manual-volatility fallback. Adaptive Supertrend, the exact volatility state, 5-minute timeframe, and no-stop status are otherwise unchanged.

strategy_roster.name: Alligator + MA Trend Catcher
strategy_roster.entry_long: close > ema(close,200) and ema(close,8) > ema(close,13) and ema(close,13) > ema(close,21)
strategy_roster.exit_long: close < ema(close,200) or ema(close,8) < ema(close,13) or ema(close,13) < ema(close,21)
strategy_roster.notes: EMA(200) is the documented long trend filter; EMA(8/13/21) is an explicit smooth-line proxy for the unavailable Alligator lips, teeth, and jaw. Alligator offsets, separate entry/exit colors, and timeframe are not expressible.

strategy_roster.name: Range EA
strategy_roster.notes: The documented 21-period average and 250-point range are normalized to a 2% offset because instrument price-step units are unavailable; the 500/250-point target and stop are not percentage fields. Trailing, step-down averaging, reversal, and session logic are omitted.

strategy_roster.name: Trend Vanguard
strategy_roster.notes: The documented Depth(21) ZigZag is approximated by EMA(20)/SMA(20) slope changes, with the inverse change as exit. The actual ZigZag swing state, intraday timing, and no-stop status are not available.

strategy_roster.name: Very Blondie System
strategy_roster.notes: The 60-bar prior high is a long-side proxy for the range-extension trigger. The four-order martingale ladder, account-currency target, lock-down, point spacing, and whether the source fades or follows each extreme are not expressible.

strategy_roster.name: Swing Breakout Strategy PRO
strategy_roster.notes: Prior 10-bar and one-bar highs approximate confirmed swing resistance and continuation; the prior 10-bar low is the opposite swing exit. Internal pivot offsets, opposite-swing stop, and range target cannot be encoded directly.

strategy_roster.name: Long Explosive V1
strategy_roster.notes: ROC(close,1)>1 is the exact scale-free translation of the documented 1% close-versus-prior-close increase; the inverse 1% drop exits. The source has no stops, and a re-entry before the prior position closes is handled by the one-position simulator.

strategy_roster.name: Renko Live Chart
strategy_roster.notes: A 1% one-bar upward move with a bullish candle is a price-momentum fallback for an upward Renko brick; the reverse is the exit. Brick size, offset, wick handling, brick persistence, and automatic protection are unavailable.

strategy_roster.name: Macd Cci
strategy_roster.notes: MACD(12,26,9) is retained exactly and RSI(14)<30 is an explicit oversold proxy for CCI<-100. The documented 2% stop is retained; CCI period/levels, the opposite MACD state wording, and short side are approximated or omitted.
